input:
At 8:30, I left my keys by the café door. 'Did you hear that?' asked May.
A quiet yellow taxi passed the old school; three children waved.

Shopping: coffee, cheese, bread, apples. Total: €12.50.
Send the receipt to ali@example.com, then write: shukraN!
